'''Tim Guzman Cloud City Engineer or Cloud City Technician''' is a strategy article [[Tim Guzman]] published on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]] as The Information Broker. The printed title is ''Cloud City Engineer(DS) or Cloud City Technician(LS)''.<ref name="or">[https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/CloudCity.htm Cloud City Engineer(DS) or Cloud City Technician(LS)], The Outer Rim (The Information Broker). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261030142214/https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/CloudCity.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Article ==

<blockquote>
<div style="white-space:pre-wrap; font-family:inherit"><nowiki>
Title: Cloud City Engineer(DS) or Cloud City Technician(LS)


First off the Deploy and Forfeit is
not to good, neither is the Power or Ability. But the game text makes up for
that. It says: When present at a converted sit, may use 2 Force to raise your
site to the top. Also, When Present at an opponent's site that has a Scomp link,
your Force drains are +1 there...... Notice the first half of the Text. Did
having your site converted by your opponent turn the tide in the game? Did your
opponent take away your Advantage? Well that's where these guys come in. You
should consider having this Character in any Ground deck. These sites weather
they are Light side or Dark side is very important to have on top: Mos Eisley,
Jundland Wastes, Cantina, Audience Chamber, any cloud city site, just to mention
a few. And I also suggest that you play this character like an interrupt.......Meaning
only put him on the table when necessary, it will surely surprise your opponent.
Remember these guys are also Non-unique aliens, so they can be used for BT or
DOT. Plus Don't forget the other half of the game text. If you can take advantage
of a force drain +1 then do it.


The
Information Broker
</nowiki></div>
</blockquote>
